offers_products.reason: Main offering is technical training programs; no goods or software sold as main offering.

offers_services.reason: Provides education and technical training in automotive, diesel, welding, HVACR at campuses.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individual students enroll and choose programs; funded by Pell grants and student loans.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are individual students; employer and manufacturer partnerships are secondary to student enrollment.

recurring_revenue.reason: Students pay tuition for finite programs of under a year to two; not ongoing repeat purchases.

cyclical_demand.reason: Vocational training enrollment tends to hold or rise in downturns as people retrain.

big_ticket.reason: Tuition for a trade program is a large, one-time expense for a student, often loan-funded.

people_delivered.reason: Instructors deliver the hands-on teaching; education is paid for mainly through staff skill and time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are individual students, not large enterprises or government agencies.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates many campuses with labs, tools and equipment needing ongoing investment in facilities and new campuses.

notes: Asset-heavy is a judgement call: campus and lab investment is substantial but not like utilities.
